label: Gini index of income inequality
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = the OECD Income Distribution Database (IDD) via SDMX (DSD_WISE_IDD@DF_IDD), the Gini of equivalized disposable income as submitted by member statistical offices (national household surveys), 45 areas, 1974-2025, unit 0_TO_1, AGE=_T, four vintage doors in a priority chain (METH2012-D_CUR > METH2012-D_PREV > METH2012-D_INC > METH2011-D_CUR — the OECD explorer's own chained display; 906 country-year keys, zero unresolved, every collision a logged provenance discard). Witness tier = the WID pre-tax Gini via OWID's chart door (165 entities, 1820-2024, the DINA research harmonization — a different income concept, the gap displayed never reconciled). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: collector print beside research harmonization, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OECD IDD = OECD Terms and Conditions, attribution required; OWID/WID witness = CC-BY-4.0 (OWID's chart-door terms; content: World Inequality Database).
notes: THE TODD ANCHORS PRINT THEMSELVES (todd_refs: 4 citations, 2 books). L'illusion économique's 1995 fifteen-country OECD table is the canonical's own concept on its own year: USA 1995 = 0.361, the exact table the book read (the door's lineage — this same OECD collection's print, 30 years deeper). La Défaite de l'Occident's US-focused reading rides both tiers: USA 1993 = 0.369 -> 2023 = 0.394 on the canonical (the survey arc), 1913 = 0.5557 -> 2024 = 0.5869 on the witness (the pre-tax arc — the two-door US story: redistribution compresses the level, the trend prints on both). THE CONCEPT SEAM (the indicator's own display case): France 2022 = 0.299 disposable vs 0.4592 pre-tax, Sweden 2023 = 0.289 disposable vs ~0.4x pre-tax — the gap IS the tax-and-transfer system, the distributional question Todd's Qui est Charlie ? inequality structure asks, printed by two doors that never reconcile. THE STITCHING (the quatuor's own story, every seam in the coverage report): France sews at 2011 and 2020, Germany at 2011, the USA at 2013, the UK at 2002 — METH2012 wherever it prints, the definition back-series before each break, METH2011 carrying the history. RUSSIA: 5 points 2008-2017 (0.428 -> 0.317, the RLMS survey window — the canonical's own honest freeze; the witness carries the WID arc 1820-2017 including the Soviet low). BRAZIL rides the D_INC door (2006 = 0.5088 — the back-series variant it prints). THE HONEST LIMITS: 45 areas canonical (OECD+ — the world face rides the witness tier alone, the same tier split every indicator carries); no sex dimension (the flow prints none — a household- distribution index); the IDD's non-gini measures (decile ratios, Palma, poverty rates) enumerated and left as the recorded non-wired doors; the WB Gini chart (gini-coefficient-wb, 183 entities 1963-2025, the PIP survey face) and the LIS chart probed live — same-root alternatives to the witness door, not wired (one witness, the minimal-door discipline).
